USE nyc_taxi_ldw;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE gold.usp_gold_trip_data_green
(
    @year VARCHAR(4),
    @month VARCHAR(2)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @create_sql_stmt NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @drop_sql_stmt NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @table_name NVARCHAR(100);

    SET @table_name = 'trip_data_green_' + @year + '_' + @month;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Drop external table if exists
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sys.external_tables
        WHERE name = @table_name
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @drop_sql_stmt =
            'DROP EXTERNAL TABLE gold.' + QUOTENAME(@table_name);

        PRINT @drop_sql_stmt;
        EXEC sp_executesql @drop_sql_stmt;
    END

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Create Gold External Table
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @create_sql_stmt = '
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.' + QUOTENAME(@table_name) + '
    WITH
    (
        DATA_SOURCE = nyc_taxi_src,
        LOCATION = ''gold/trip_data_green/year=' + @year + '/month=' + @month + ''',
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_file_format
    )
    AS

    SELECT

        td.year,
        td.month,

        tz.Borough,

        CONVERT(date, td.lpep_pickup_datetime) AS trip_date,

        cal.day_name AS trip_day,

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN cal.day_name IN (''Saturday'',''Sunday'')
                    THEN ''Y''
                ELSE ''N''
            END
        AS CHAR(1)) AS trip_day_weekend_ind,

        SUM(CASE WHEN pt.description = ''Credit card'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS card_trip_count,

        SUM(CASE WHEN pt.description = ''Cash'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cash_trip_count,

        SUM(CASE WHEN tt.trip_type_desc = ''Street-hail'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS street_hail_trip_count,

        SUM(CASE WHEN tt.trip_type_desc = ''Dispatch'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatch_trip_count,

        SUM(td.trip_distance) AS trip_distance,

        SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE,
            td.lpep_pickup_datetime,
            td.lpep_dropoff_datetime)) AS trip_duration,

        SUM(td.fare_amount) AS fare_amount

    FROM silver.vw_trip_data_green td

    INNER JOIN silver.taxi_zone tz
        ON td.pu_location_id = tz.LocationID

    INNER JOIN silver.calendar cal
        ON cal.date = CONVERT(date, td.lpep_pickup_datetime)

    INNER JOIN silver.payment_type pt
        ON td.payment_type = pt.payment_type

    INNER JOIN silver.trip_type tt
        ON td.trip_type = tt.trip_type

    WHERE td.year = ''' + @year + '''
      AND td.month = ''' + @month + '''

    GROUP BY

        td.year,
        td.month,
        tz.Borough,
        CONVERT(date, td.lpep_pickup_datetime),
        cal.day_name;
    ';

    PRINT @create_sql_stmt;

    EXEC sp_executesql @create_sql_stmt;

END;
GO
